senses.gloss: (b. h.), Hif. הִשְׁרִישׁ (denom. of שֹׁרֶשׁ) to take root.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sheviit 2:7">Shebi. II, 7</cite> <he>שהִשְׁרִישׁוּ לפני וכ׳</he> which have taken root before the New Year; <cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 13b">R. Hash. 13ᵇ</cite>.
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 13b">Ib.</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Shevi'it 2:5">Tosef. Shebi. II, 5</cite> <he>ומקצתו ה׳ לאחר וכ׳</he> and part of which took root after the New Year; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to uproot, tear out. Ib. 11, sq. אין … לשָׁרֵשׁ וכ׳ we do not force him to tear out &c.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sheviit 4:4">Shebi. IV, 4</cite> <he>יְשָׁרֵשׁ</he> he must take it out with the root, opp. <he>יגום</he>, v. <cite ref="C01054"><he>גָּמַם</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 80b:10">B. Bath. 80ᵇ</cite> <he>חופר ומְשָׁרֵשׁ</he> he has the right to dig and take them out with the roots; <cite ref="Taanit 25b:2">Taan. 25ᵇ</cite> <he>חופר … ומְשָׁרֵישׁ</he>.

senses.gloss: to be uprooted, plucked out. Tanḥ. M’tsorʿa 2 (ref. to Ps. LII, 7) דואג נ׳ וכ׳ Doeg was rooted out of the life of this world and of the hereafter.

units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 14">Num. R. s. 14<sup>4</sup></cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Ecclesiastes 12:11">Koh. XII, 11</cite>) <he>כשם … מִשְׁתָּרְשִׁים … ומשתרשים וכ׳</he> as roots of a tree spread in all directions, so the words of the Law enter and penetrate the whole body; (<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 3:1">Pesik. R. s. 3</cite> <he>משתילים</he>).

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 67b">B. Kam. 67ᵇ</cite> sq. <he>מפני שנ׳ בחטא</he> because he became the gainer in sin (he gained possession of the stolen object by a change of form or ownership, v. <cite ref="U00973"><he>שִׁינּוּי</he></cite>); <he>אילימא לפני יאוש מי איכא נ׳</he> if you mean (that he slaughtered or sold it) before the owner had given it up (v. <cite ref="J00009"><he>יֵאוּשׁ</he></cite>): there is no gain in sin in the case (since he has not gained possession through the change).
